Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Condensate 
 Extraction Pump

WKTA 300/6
 KSB-Germany
Introduction

This document outlines equipment inspection I2, to be preformed every 
8000 working hours as indicated by H8000 in the title block.

The 
motor of the pump: type ANVE - WT 001, Teco Electric & Machinery Co. LTD Taiwan

The first draft initiated by eng. Emad Khames, reviewed by eng. Medhat El-Damaty, tested by eng. Mohamed Alkhateb Mohamed Salem, accepted by eng. Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Hassan Zayed, approved 
 by eng. Abdel Mageed Abdel Qawey Emarah: Head Sector of 
 Sidi Kirir Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC 
 engineering consultant A and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

The motor have to be stopped and its breaker isolated before starting any 
 maintenance procedure

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check the (teeth, 
gear seals, sealing faces) coupling and alignment coupling (air gap:40 
(tolerance +2,-5)mm, radial:0.56, axial 0.22)

Change the oil for motor 
upper bearing (oil approximate 60L oil - mobil oil heavy medium ISO - VG 68).

Change the oil for pump 
thrust bearing (oil approximate 40L oil- mobil DTE light ISOVG 32).

Change of the grease 
mobilux 3 (140g) for lower bearing of motor.

Change of the grease 
mobilux EP 004 (0.86 dm3) for coupling.

Check the tighten of all 
bolts for the pump and motor.

Clean the cooling water 
pipes of thrust bearings (pump and motor)

Check the goodness of 
inlet outlet sealing water drain and vent valves.

General cleaning for the 
external pump body.

Check the packing (6pieces 
- 10mm - LATT, YFLON 4788) lantern ring shaft protecting sleeve and change if 
required

Check the cooling for the 
packing.
